issues.description: The declaration of Bitmap24::resize_buffer in the template header uses parameters of type 'long' (long i_width, long i_height), but the implementation in Bitmap24.cpp uses 'int' parameters (int i_width, int i_height). The solution repository's header uses 'int' as well. This mismatch between the header declaration and the implementation will cause a signature/type inconsistency that can prevent successful compilation or lead to ODR/mangling errors and will confuse students about the correct parameter types to implement/use.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the header declaration in the template match the implementation (and the solution). Change the resize_buffer signature in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'void resize_buffer(long i_width, long i_height)' to 'void resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height)'. This aligns template, implementation, and solution and prevents compilation/mangling errors while preserving the intended API.
